note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a TAN 9, Schedule 2; A06b TAN 9, Schedule 2; L05 TAN 7(4)): ordinary naturalisation after 7 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Tanzania, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident for 12 months prior to the application and at least 7 years during previous 10 years. ... Renunciation of other citizenship required. ... Person acquired citizenship of another country by voluntary act other than marriage, or acquired the citizenship of another country and fails to renounce Tanzanian citizenship.
